$comment: The signs each city needs, generated by tools/signs.ts (which the bake calls). The GLBs live under public/models/signs and are gitignored: assets are generated, the recipe is what is kept. A landmark entry names the file in its `file` field.

san-francisco.note: Ghirardelli Square's roof sign, read from the bay: mixed case, bulbs along the letters, standing on the steel lattice drawn by the `ghirardelliSign` builder

Ripley's at 175 Jefferson: the yellow sign over the arched entrance. Bold italic, mixed case — the block font could not carry the exclamation mark or the lowercase, and this sign is most of what identifies the building
